generation_settings.grammar:
root ::= "{" space tool-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
tool ::= ("\"inventory.check_stock\"" | "\"inventory.adjust_stock\"" | "\"inventory.reserve_stock\"" | "\"warehouse.locate_bin\"" | "\"receiving.log_arrival\"" | "\"picking.create_task\"" | "\"reports.export_snapshot\"" | "\"alerts.raise_low_stock\"")
tool-kv ::= "\"tool\"" space ":" space tool

http.prompt:
Known: order ORD-1042, customer C-9, sku SKU-1001, tracking TRK-88771.
Available tools:
- inventory.check_stock: 查询库存 / check stock (params: sku)
- inventory.adjust_stock: 调整库存 / adjust stock (params: sku, quantity)
- inventory.reserve_stock: 预留库存 / reserve stock (params: sku, quantity)
- warehouse.locate_bin: 定位货位 / locate a bin (params: bin_id)
- receiving.log_arrival: 登记到货 / log an arrival (params: shipment_no)
- picking.create_task: 创建拣货任务 / create a picking task (params: order_id)
- reports.export_snapshot: 导出快照 / export a snapshot (params: zone)
- alerts.raise_low_stock: 上报低库存 / raise a low-stock alert (params: sku)
Export the stock snapshot for zone north. 只回答要调用的工具名。 / Answer with the tool name only.
Respond with the answer only, no explanation.
